crossRefs.note: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

parallels.note: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

translations.web: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
translations.bsb: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
translations.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
translations.asv: And if Satan hath rise up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
